5495 items from 12 static Wikibase instances in one bundle of 144178 triples. Filters inside a group combine with “or”, groups combine with “and”. Items that only describe the data model are hidden until you ask for them. Regions are coarse boxes set by the registry (crosswalks/regions.csv), not an authority.
